say: Claude is spelled the way Anthropic spells it, in Latin letters.
The author is a woman: feminine past tense and short adjectives in the first person.
The author is a woman: feminine present tense and adjectives in the first person.
Brand names stay in Latin letters in Hebrew (Honda, Harley, Corolla, IKEA, Nikon, Tesla, Google…).
Generic "you" is du (or man), not Sie.
です/ます with 私; no plain-form sentence endings.
No dashes she didn't write (Russian copula dashes are grammar, not style: approve them in ok.json).
A dotted name like system.settings or music.ogg keeps its ending in English in every translation; the part before the dot may be translated.
